tagline_en: Speak, write and argue in English with confidence, precision and style.
tagline_ar: اتكلّم واكتب وناقش بالإنجليزي بثقة ودقّة وأسلوب راقي.
intro_ar: المستوى ده للي خلّص المستويات من الأول للرابع وعايز يوصل لإنجليزي طبيعي ومتمكّن. في ١٢ أسبوع هتتعلّم تحكي قصة باحتراف، وتكتب مقال وتقرير وإيميل رسمي من ٢٠٠ لـ ٢٥٠ كلمة، وتقدّم عرض وتناقش رأيك بثقة، بنفس الأسلوب اللي بيستخدمه أهل اللغة في الشغل والجامعة.
can_do: After this level you can tell detailed stories using the past perfect continuous, the future in the past (was going to / was about to / would) and narrative time linkers.
After this level you can write well-organised essays, reports, reviews and formal emails of 200–250 words.
After this level you can emphasise, soften and structure your ideas with cleft sentences, inversion, participle clauses and hedging.
After this level you can follow BBC 6 Minute English episodes and TED talks on serious topics and discuss them.
After this level you can give a short presentation and take part in a debate, agreeing, disagreeing and conceding politely.
After this level you can use 360 new B2 words, collocations and idioms naturally.

items.name: BBC Learning English – The English We Speak (podcast)

end.title: You Finished Level 5! What Next?
end.intro: Congratulations — you have completed the Upper-Intermediate level: 360 new words and expressions, 120 key sentences and the grammar that makes English sound fluent and natural. You are now a confident B2 user of English.
next_steps: Listen to one full 6 Minute English episode (podcast) and watch one TED-Ed animation or engVid lesson (Adam, Alex, Benjamin or James) every week, now without subtitles.
Move on to British Council C1 listening and C1 reading.
Read one longer article a week (for example from BBC News) and note five new collocations.
Write one 250-word essay, report or email every week and ask a teacher to correct it.
If you need a certificate, start preparing for IELTS (band 6.0–6.5) or Cambridge B2 First.
Review the 120 sentences of this level once a week for the next month.
end.tip_ar: في هذا المستوى لا يكمن الفرق في معرفة القواعد بل في استخدامها: اكتب أو قل كل يوم ثلاث جمل عن حياتك بتعبيرات هذا المستوى، وراجع الجمل الـ١٢٠ مرة كل أسبوع حتى تصبح جزءًا من كلامك الطبيعي.
